property_summary: Calling assertionDisputedCallback does not change the return value of getAssertionPolicy for the same assertionId.
getAssertionPolicy returns blockAssertion false for any assertionId
Calling assertionDisputedCallback with a given assertionId does not change the return value of getAssertionPolicy for that assertionId.
The return value of getAssertionPolicy(assertionId)[blockAssertion] is false for any assertionId.
The blockAssertion field of getAssertionPolicy is always false for any assertionId.
For any assertionId, calling getAssertionPolicy should return arbitrateViaEscalationManager as false.
After any call to assertionDisputedCallback, the getAssertionPolicy for the same assertionId must have discardOracle == false.
Calling getAssertionPolicy with any assertionId must return validateDisputers false.
For any assertion ID and dispute caller, isDisputeAllowed must return true when called from assertionDisputedCallback.
For any valid assertionId, calling assertionDisputedCallback does not change the return value of getPrice(bytes32,uint256,bytes) for any fixed arguments.
The return value of getPrice must be the default int256 value (0) before and after assertionDisputedCallback is called.
For any bytes32 assertionId, calling assertionDisputedCallback does not emit PriceRequestAdded events.
Calling assertionDisputedCallback with any assertionId never emits a PriceRequestAdded event.
Calling assertionDisputedCallback does not emit PriceRequestAdded events regardless of the assertionId parameter.
Calling assertionDisputedCallback with any assertionId does not emit a PriceRequestAdded event.
Calling assertionDisputedCallback with any bytes32 argument does not emit a PriceRequestAdded event.
The assertionDisputedCallback function does not revert for any bytes32 input.
Calling assertionDisputedCallback on the reference contract always succeeds (does not revert), while the mutant always reverts.
